findings.reason: F0003:S3:T1:A4 explicitly leaves the uncertainty type unstated. The item provides no sample count, animal identifiers, sampling design or derivation of the exposure summaries. Reported ± values cannot be classified as SD, SEM or another uncertainty measure.
